//: What a person strikes with, beside the fist, the heel and the elbow their parts already have: the flat of the hand for a shove, the sole of the foot for a stamp or a push kick, the brow for a headbutt. Area is the contact in square metres; give is how far the blow is stopped over; span is how far across the target it touches. A wide, yielding surface spreads its energy and pushes; a small, hard one concentrates it (07 §3.2, §6.1).
